body:
Hi @iHamza14,

I have completed the migration of `site-moderator/check-recent-feedback-messages` to Playwright.

**Branch:** [`abdulhamid999:migrate-site-moderator-check-recent-feedback-messages`](https://github.com/abdulhamid999/oppia/tree/migrate-site-moderator-check-recent-feedback-messages)

### Summary of Changes
- **`core/tests/ci-test-suite-configs/acceptance.json`**: Updated configuration for `site-moderator/check-recent-feedback-messages` to `"framework": "playwright"`.
- **`core/tests/playwright-acceptance-tests/specs/site-moderator/check-recent-feedback-messages.spec.ts`**: Migrated acceptance test to Playwright using `BaseUser` and role-based actions.
- **`core/tests/puppeteer-acceptance-tests/specs/site-moderator/check-recent-feedback-messages.spec.ts`**: Removed legacy Puppeteer spec.
- **`core/tests/playwright-acceptance-tests/utilities/user/moderator.ts`**: Implemented `Moderator` user class with actions to navigate to the Moderator page, view Recent Feedback Messages tab, and verify feedback table entries.
- **`core/tests/playwright-acceptance-tests/utilities/common/user-factory.ts`**: Registered `ROLES.MODERATOR` factory.
- **`core/tests/playwright-acceptance-tests/utilities/user/logged-out-user.ts`**: Added `giveFeedback` helper method.
- **`core/tests/playwright-acceptance-tests/utilities/common/playwright-utils.ts`**: Added `parseLocaleAbbreviatedDatetimeString` datetime helper.
- **Screenshots**: Added new Playwright baseline screenshots for Desktop and Mobile (dev & prod) and removed legacy Puppeteer snapshots.

### Verification & Proofs
- **200-Run Stress Test (100 Desktop + 100 Mobile)**:
  https://github.com/abdulhamid999/oppia/actions/runs/42498974451 (Passed 100% — 203/203 jobs completed with 0 failures)
- **Single Verification Run**:
  https://github.com/abdulhamid999/oppia/actions/runs/42497871340 (Passed 100% — both Desktop and Mobile green)
- **Video Recordings Workflow Run**:
  https://github.com/abdulhamid999/oppia/actions/runs/42495764228 (Available under artifacts: `video-recordings_site-moderator_check-recent-feedback-messages-1-desktop` and `video-recordings_site-moderator_check-recent-feedback-messages-1-mobile`)

Could you please assign `site-moderator/check-recent-feedback-messages` to me so I can open the PR against `oppia:develop`? Thank you!
